[[Siege Wurm]]s are gigantic stationary wurms that launch siege-like projectiles at you from a distance of [[spirit range]]. They can withstand a lot of damage and deal a lot of damage themselves.

== Notes ==
*Siege Wurms have 960 health.
*Their [[aggro]] radius is about spirit range.
*Unlike normal Siege Wurms, those in [[Annihilator 2: Searing Day]] have both siege and melee attacks, have normal aggro range, and follow players.
